notes.title: Minions Update
notes.content:
[h2]List of changes v0.1.21
[/h2]
[h3]We have Minions now so you don't have to go into the dark alone and a host of other fixes and tweaks.[/h3]

[b]NEW:
[/b]New Wisp, Boarman and Dark Wizard minion can be unlocked from the title screen.
- Each minion has different attacks and passive buff ability to aid the player
- Wisp: standard melee and ranged attack; increase player dodge chance by 33%
- Boarman: standard melee and stunned range; increase player armour within range
- Wizard: standard melee and mind-control attack; increase player cast speed within range

[previewyoutube=ghzYtwg8e9s;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]FIXES:[/b]
- Tweaked collision for trees for better path movement
- Upgrade selection / screen freeze issue
- Path mesh overlapping with edge of level


[b]QUALITY OF LIFE:[/b]
- Glyph and function added to different menu screens to go 'back'

Enjoy and as always please feel free to leave us feedback.

notes.title: Early Access Release day!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Huge thanks for playing the game! if you just got the game, [b]BIG WELCOME[/b]! if you have been testing recently then below is the most recent updates to the game.

[u]List of changes v0.1.18 (Early Access Patch)
[/u]
- Added a new boss variant 'Wizard Goblin' that casts magic
- Updated current Goblin boss which now has a charge ability
- Updated fonts
- Fixed boss encounter not registering correctly
- Fixed upgrade issue after obtaining first weapon

[b]Over the first week of launch we will prioritize fixing major issues that pop up and will share the roadmap for Yokai Survivor during this time too, with many more levels, ninjutsu abilities, yokais, features, and fun to come![/b]

If you have any feedback or encountered any bugs, please let us know in the Steam discussion board, comments or on our Discord at https://discord.gg/tD8QdkE7K9

Enjoy playing!

tags.feature: - Added a new boss variant 'Wizard Goblin' that casts magic
- Updated current Goblin boss which now has a charge ability
- Updated fonts

tags.bug: - Fixed boss encounter not registering correctly
- Fixed upgrade issue after obtaining first weapon

notes.title: Early Access Patch v0.1.12
notes.content:
Hi all,

Here's our first patch with lots of updates in preparation for the Early Access release.

List of changes v0.1.12 (Early Access Patch)
- Added Charms pickups to buff the player for 30 seconds
	- heals player 1hp/s
	- Add 50% critical hit chance
	- increase damage by 50%
	- increase player speed by 25%
- Added Curse pickups to curse either the Player or Yokais for 30 seconds
	- increase Yokais speed by 25%
	- increase Yokais damage by 25%
	- slow Yokais speed by 25%
	- poison Yokais by 1hp/s
	- confuse Yokais which cause them to target the closes character to them
- Added treasure chest that randomly spawn throughout the run
- Added new Mimic and Kappa enemy
- Added Gold coin bag
- Added game objective related messages to assist player
- Fixed earthquake projectile not hitting the round
- Fixed regular enemies defeated not tracking
- Updated current weapons/abilities to target closes enemy
- Updated HUDs
- Updated camera post coloring effects
- Updated damage/loot value popup design
- Updated controller support with glyphs

If you have any feedback or encountered any bugs, please let us know in the Steam discussion board, comments or on our Discord at https://discord.gg/tD8QdkE7K9

Enjoy playing!
